note: Anguilla: a work permit under the Control of Employment Act. Executive Council exempts visiting bands and artistes by name for particular events under section 3(g) (Moonsplash, 2016); an exemption decided event by event isn't modelled as days. British citizens and the other territories' passports, though of the same nationality, need it too and are named; the territory's own are home. Route corrected 2026-11-01 from the permit research (papers.permits.AI): it was “Work permit (Control of Employment Act)”.

sources.title: Government of Anguilla, Minutes of the 46th Meeting of the Eleventh Executive Council, 14 April 2016, EX MIN 16/234
sources.said: agreed that the members of the bands and musical artistes named on the ... attached list should be exempted from the requirement of a work permit in ... accordance with Section 3 (g) of the Control of Employment Act.

sources.title: Labour (Relations) Act, R.S.A. c. L7 (revised 31/12/2022), Part 11 Work Permits, ss. 164-178 (Government of Anguilla)
sources.said: (d) vary, renew or extend a work permit. … 165. (1) There are 3 categories of work permits— (a) a general work permit; (b) a temporary work permit; and (c) a self-employment work permit. … (a) processing all applications for work permits; … A person who seeks to be self-employed or a prospective employer may apply for a work permit in the manner prescribed. … that the prospective employer has sought by advertising for at least 2 consecutive weeks in a media outlet approved by the Commissioner to ascertain the availability of any one or more of the following in the order in which they are listed— … the Minister may grant a work permit for a term that the Minister considers necessary, but any term shall not exceed one year. … The Minister shall specify in the prescribed manner the fee and security deposit to be paid solely by the employer for every application for grant, renewal or extension of a work permit under this Part.
